meta.description: Cross-dimensional resonance definitions for the Astrolabium. Supplements the 18 structural compounds in detect_compounds() with 13 additional resonance types covering elemental, qualitative, rhythmic, and calendrical alignments.

wu_xing_element_match.description: Primeval Law's trigram Wu Xing matches active organ's Wu Xing element

vessel_organ_element_match.description: Derivative vessel's associated trigram Wu Xing matches active organ's Wu Xing element

plum_blossom_wu_xing.description: Primeval trigram's Plum Blossom Wu Xing assignment matches active organ's Wu Xing element. Plum Blossom uses DIFFERENT Wu Xing mapping than standard trigram Wu Xing

color_affinity.description: Law color matches the organ's healing color

emotion_perception.description: Organ emotional quality resonates with Law perception pair

adonaj_ba_proximity.description: Law's Adonaj-Ba energy center has anatomical relationship with active organ

waxing_wing_alignment.description: Lunar phase direction matches solar wing. Waxing + Day = aligned. Waning + Night = aligned

yang_count.description: Lunar phase yang line count (0→1→2→3→2→1). State value tracking position in energetic wave

sephirotic_quest_match.description: Sephirotic day's planet matches a Law's Quest Tarot Continental attribution

season_great_rite.description: Organ season matches calendar month's seasonal position via Great Rite

alchemical_stage.description: Current month's alchemical stage: Nigredo (1-4), Albedo (5-8), Rubedo (9-12), Da'ath (13)

month_group.description: Current month's group: Osirian, Falcon, Operative, Tappetino

iao_position.description: Month's IAO letter: I (ISIS), O (OSIRIS), A (SET), or null

stem_trigram_polarity.description: Daily stem polarity (Yang/Yin) matches primeval trigram polarity. Double-yang or double-yin amplifies the polarity signal

organ_vessel_polarity.description: Active organ's Yin/Yang classification matches derivative vessel's polarity. Yin organ + Yin vessel or Yang organ + Yang vessel = polarity doubling

paired_organ_vessel_point.description: The paired organ (TCM interior/exterior pair) hosts the derivative vessel's confluent or coupled point. Extends anatomical intersection to the paired meridian

divine_hour_law_unity.description: When Two-Body Unity is active, reports which Divine Hour holds it. State value providing hour context for Law Unity windows

plum_blossom_wu_xing_map._note: Maps Plum Blossom assignment to a Wu Xing element for comparison. Imperial Fire and Min. Fire map to Fire; Yang/Yin Water map to Water; etc.

color_affinity_map._note: Grades: EXACT (same color term), NATURAL (recognizable affinity), NONE (no meaningful match). Keyed as 'LawColor:HealingColor'.

emotion_perception_map._note: Grades semantic resonance between organ emotion and Law perception. Keyed as 'Law:Element:polarity'. polarity = pos or neg.

adonaj_ba_organ_map._note: Grades anatomical relationship between Adonaj-Ba center and organ. EXACT = same region. ADJACENT = neighboring region. PROXIMAL = related via meridian pathway. NONE = no meaningful relationship.

quest_planet_map._note: Maps Quest Tarot card names to their Continental (Lévi) planetary attribution.

quest_to_sephirotic_planet._note: Maps Quest Tarot Continental attributions to sephirotic planet names for R_SPH_01 matching. Only planetary attributions (not elements/signs) can match sephirotic planets.

trigram_polarity._note: Maps the 6 cyclic trigrams to their Yin/Yang polarity. Kǎn and Lí excluded (Solar Keys, not in cycle).

season_great_rite_map._note: Maps organ season to Great Rite seasonal alignment.

_field_coverage_note: Field categorization (resonance, compound, identity, structural) is maintained in src/meta_registry.py FIELD_REGISTRY. The dimensional_pairs_exempt list was replaced by the two-level field census approach.

elemental_silo_violations._note: Wu Xing and Damanhurian elements are SEPARATE systems. Cross-comparisons are structurally prohibited, not merely exempt.
